title: Born on Liberty Street at the edge of the District
summary: Wynn describes the block where he was born, on the edge of the District near Gravier Street.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: It's usually that way, but a couple of times on some records, they put the E on the end. One of the old Brunswick's. Yeah. I think it was. The old Vocalion record. The ones you made with punch. Now, where were you born? In which part of town? Uptown or downtown?

I was born on Liberty Street between Tulane and Gravy. I don't remember the address. I thought it was, that's right on the edge of the district. At that time, the district was on Gravy Street. But this particular block on Liberty was a very nice block. Very nice, well kept and pretty flowers out front. I remember that much about it.
Up over between Perdido and Gravy or up that way is where the district was more.
Yeah, well the starting of it was at, at that time, the starting of it was at Liberty Street on Gravy. Yeah. And it went on up. I remember that much from it.
And Louis Armstrong was raised right up. Is that right? That neighborhood too.
